title: Repo Governor Spec Kit feature map, version 1
$comment: One file per repository, at .repo-governor/speckit-features.json (ADR-037 decision 3). It declares which authority id a Spec Kit feature directory is governed by. Written by a human and committed; never derived from a directory name, a branch name or spec text (ADR-028). Read by engine/features.py, validated by engine/manifest.py --validate.

features.$comment: Key: the feature directory name under specs/, exactly as written (numbered or not; 23.6% of Spec Kit repositories do not number features). Value: the authority id the engine asks about, the same shape as an acceptance bar's authority_id.
